name: @cyclone-ui/drawer
description: A side panel built on the Cyclone UI Sheet that slides in from the right by default and comes in sm, md and lg sizes. It has Frame, Content, Handle, Overlay, ScrollView, Header (with optional back and close buttons), Title, Description, Heading, Body and Footer parts; Content is a bordered panel inset in the Frame that keeps the Header pinned and scrolls the rest once it overflows, and the Footer stays visible below it. Use it for navigation, filters or secondary content shown beside the main view.
